   - On subprocess exception respond with 500 and `{"status":"Error","message":"Failed to start inventory check"}`.
   - On success respond with `{"status":"Inventory check started","section":<section>}`.

   - On success respond with `{"status":"Book details updated","isbn":..., "new_title":..., "new_author":..., "new_genre":..., "new_publication_year":...}`.

   - On success respond with `{"status":"Report generation started","type":<type>}`.

   - On subprocess exception respond 500 with `{"status":"Error","message":"Failed to retrieve books"}`.
   - On success respond with `{"status":"Books retrieval initiated","category":<category>}`.

   - On YAML error respond 400 with `{"status":"Error","message":"Invalid YAML format"}`.

    - On success respond with `{"status":"Member details updated","id":..., "new_name":..., "new_membership_date":...}`.
